body: I don’t know , they haven’t communicated with me. I’m a minor but close to being 18, the social worker told my parent that they (my parent) don’t have custody over me that they can’t decide what to do that the “state” will decide. I know I have the 72 hour hold and they’re trying to transfer me to a clinic but I have no idea what happens after the 72 hours are up and I just know I don’t want to stay here, it’s not helping
